notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content:
Patch notes : 
-New skill menu with skill points to spend on level up
-New NPC dialog
-New Knight enemy
-Added fall damage
-Added voxel based path finding for every enemy (they don't just run straight for you they avoid holes and obstacles)
-Added unique sounds to every enemy
-The big bat has a second phase
-You now start the game with a class based hood and cape
-The player is now invincible during the loading screen
-Wolves are more wild and fast
-Enemy's vertical motion is more smooth when going up and down voxels
-Added houses, ruins and towers with random chest at the surface (you can repair and defend them)
-You can destroy voxels in the main menu
-Added button sfx and animation in the main menu
-Player is invisible only with a pickaxe in hand
-Added an intro cinematic to introduce lore
-Added a charged attack and air attacks with shortsword
-Added start running animation + stop running animation
-Fixed loud sfx when loading your world on a loaded save
-Heat radius of torches and campires increased
-The logo is more mature
-Red mushrooms are easier to pick up on the ground
-Impossible to spawn underground anymore
-The iron axe gives more wood
-You can shift click to auto equip armor or quick stack into chests
-Longer tutorial to really get you into the game
-Wishlist buttons added everywhere
-Suspicious looking organ is now craftable
-Cyclope Bats drop bat wings
-Added cheatcodes
-Added a thx for playing screen
-Torch vfx is less intense in your hands
-Crystal hearts and Mana mushrooms are now underground
-Enemyies and bosses get stronger every day
-You now burn when stepping n magma stone and bedrock
-Colors are less saturated and the ambient occlusion is more precise
-Added lens flares to the sun and the moon
-Cannot craft while in a chest anymore
-Trees have better lighting at night
-You can double jump with max agility
-You now gain max health from leveling up vitality
-The world is 3 blocks deeper
-You don't slide on the ground when you stop moving anymore unless you have momentum
-Added a leaning motion to the characters when you turn fast while moving
-Mining and chopping down trees gives xp
-Added a compass to know where is your base
-You can now directly look 90 degrees upwards (was locked at 60 before)
-You now start with a wooden pickaxe when spawning for the first time
-You can't waste you potions when you are at full health or full mana anymore
-Chunks of dirt randomly spawn underground
-Object batching and shadow maps (optimisation)
-Removed random objects floating in the void or sticking to bedrock (optimisation)
-Fixed isolated single block of air in caves (optimisation)
-Enemies you can't see are not animated anymore (optimisation)
-New items : Iron daggers, fire arrows, Bat wings
-Worm boss removed from the demo
-Player automatically equips a torch at night or in a cave
-Added Screenspace sun rays
-Minimap got reworked

notes.title: Miner Rogue Demo Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
Here are the patch notes :

[list]
[*] added dlss + fsr (optional)
[*] volumetric fog can be remove in the settings
[*] the map is now fixed (less fog on the map + cave map is working)
[*] recipe book progress now saves with your character
[*] don't need to do the tutorial every time you load a world
[*] caves are a bit more smooth
[*] voxels are more shaped like cubes and less smooth
[*] fixed weird character rotation when in the character creation menu
[*] you stop aiming when you put the bow away
[*] you can now cancel the landing animation with an attack
[*] you are not forced to walk durring melee attacking now (new animation sets)
[*] plant loot don't spawn in the ground anymore
[*] added critical damage to some of weapons
[*] fixed that some items did not notify you when you picked them up
[*] player feet are less likely to go in the ground during an animation
[*] you now walk slower but your can sprint (you automaticly sprinted all the time before)
[*] the worm boss now growls before attacking to give you time to react
[*] bosses and enemys don't destroy trees anymore
[*] (it was weird and laggy)
[*] golems dont pop in and out of render when you baerly see them
[*] big trees don't fly and roll around when you cut them
[*] dragonners dispawn at day time
[*] added rain
[*] ambient sounds fade off if you are in your house or deep in a cave
[*] hunger value rounded when eating
[*] the building music has a chance to start playing when you start building
[*] added a chat to inform the player about evil presences
[*] big bat can now spawn naturaly
[*] the character becomes invisible when the camera is too close making it easier to mine in the caves
[*] added a cave music
[*] less likely to spawn underground when creating a world
[*] doging is a lot less forgiving
[*] don't stay locked in walking speed after respawn when dying during drinking a potion
[*] the campfire now makes a looping fire sfx
[*] added a few first person animations (work in progress)
[*] new difficulty settings (Classic, Expert and Master)
[/list]
Have fun! ❤️

notes.title: Miner Rogue Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.content:
Here are the patch notes :

[list]
[*] You can now respawn
[*] You can save your world and your character
[*] Hardcore difficulty added
[*] The nights are not pitch black
[*] Torches emit more light
[*] Iron voxels are more obvious and more common
[*] Stone structures are now invincible
[*] You can break crystal hearts with most weapons
[*] The terrain visual style is back to a more voxel look
[*] Hunger is removed until more food is added to the game
[*] Map is not zoomed all the way in when you open it
[*] Health potions only require 2 mushrooms
[*] Campfires don't require stone
[*] Freezing is less deadly
[*] You passively regenerate a small amount of health over time
[*] Bushes spawn rate is now  +300%
[*] All the tree models got reworked
[*] The fog is more colored and more dense
[*] The digging speed is 50% slower (it was a bug)
[*] Added the option to lower the render distance
[*] You can't accidentally mine your house when clicking in your inventory with a pickaxe in your hand
[*] Magma voxels now give magma stone instead of dirt (unlocking the Fire staff)
[*] Switching out of your hammer closes the build menu
[*] Can't spawn infinite minions by spamming the staff
[*] Worm boss invocators now have 200 hp instead of 100 hp
[*] Big health potions are twice as cheap to craft
[*] Added a patch notes button 😄
[/list]
Have fun! ❤️
